headword: {三十三回忌|さんじゅうさんかいき}
reading: さんじゅうさんかいき

definitions.explanation: The Buddhist memorial service held on the 33rd anniversary of a person's death (counted in the Japanese way, with the year of death counted as the first year). In many traditions, this is the final major memorial service, after which the deceased is considered to have fully become a Buddha or ancestral spirit.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}の{三十三回忌|さんじゅうさんかいき}を{営|いとな}んだ。
examples.english: We held the 33rd memorial service for my grandfather.

examples.japanese: {三十三回忌|さんじゅうさんかいき}は{多|おお}くの{家|いえ}で{弔|とむら}いの{区切|くぎ}りとされている。
examples.english: The 33rd memorial service is considered a milestone in mourning by many families.

examples.japanese: {親族|しんぞく}が{集|あつ}まり、{三十三回忌|さんじゅうさんかいき}の{法要|ほうよう}を{寺|てら}でおこなった。
examples.english: The family gathered at the temple to perform the 33rd death anniversary memorial rite.

notes:
Part of the Japanese Buddhist memorial service ({法要|ほうよう}) system. Major services are held at set intervals: {一周忌|いっしゅうき} (1st year), {三回忌|さんかいき} (3rd year), {七回忌|ななかいき} (7th year), {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき} (13th year), {十七回忌|じゅうしちかいき} (17th year), {二十三回忌|にじゅうさんかいき} (23rd year), and {三十三回忌|さんじゅうさんかいき} (33rd year).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三十三回忌|さんじゅうさんかいき}を{営|いとな}む: to hold the 33rd memorial service
- {三十三回忌|さんじゅうさんかいき}の{法要|ほうよう}: the 33rd memorial rite
- {三十三回忌|さんじゅうさんかいき}で{弔|とむら}いを{上|あ}げる: to complete mourning at the 33rd service
